LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 1.1.1 ATTENTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How should we respond to instructions?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify nouns in singular and plural forms from a song for information
2. respond to verbal instructions for information
3. appreciate listening to various cultural songs for information

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening

Teach
• Focus skill: identify nouns in singular and plural forms from a song for information.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How should we respond to instructions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
